_about: Local tips per place id, taken only from what creators state in their YouTube video descriptions. Kept separate from data.json so weekly data updates never overwrite it. Fields: hours, price, order, note, addr (more precise address), src (creator names).

5nsfmcz.note: A long-running Chinese (Hoa) restaurant in the Cholon area.

ig4y6os.order: Hủ tiếu gõ, the classic Saigon cart noodle soup

ao5gq22.order: Both bún riêu (crab and tomato noodles) and hủ tiếu

b8goeiu.order: Bánh canh sườn cây: thick noodle soup with very large pork rib pieces and daikon
b8goeiu.note: Became popular after a review by the Vietnamese comedian Trấn Thành.

ossgk2u.order: Phở with generous toppings; the video singles out the side bowl of tiết hột gà

p0rubjw.order: Poached chicken with fragrant rice cooked in chicken stock and the house dipping sauce
p0rubjw.note: HTV describes the brand as more than 80 years old.

4a8qn6p.note: An old market of the Chinese community, with many Hoa snacks and dishes to try.

ro1epl3.order: Sticky rice from the Lan Anh stall (20,000–25,000 dong; the vendor has sold here for 49 years), Hong Kong-style rice rolls with pork, shrimp, scallop or crab (28,000–47,000 dong), Ba Lù coffee, Tăng bánh mì and the stuffed bitter melon and chilli stall
ro1epl3.note: Locals also call it chợ Thủ Đô or the "rich people's market".

n8v670u.hours: Best in the weeks before the Mid-Autumn Festival, in the evening
n8v670u.note: The lantern area spreads over Lương Nhữ Học, Hải Thượng Lãn Ông and Phú Định streets, where handmade lantern-making has been passed down through generations.

7fcntj7.order: Cơm gà xối mỡ: chicken with crispy skin over golden fried rice

gtsh9ie.order: Inside the market hall: vegetarian stir-fried vermicelli (about 30,000 dong) and sâm bổ lượng iced sweet soup (about 20,000 dong)
gtsh9ie.note: One of Saigon's old markets with distinctive architecture, and a good place to buy dried goods for Chinese cooking. In the evening, stalls nearby sell stir-fried noodles.

0nw7att.addr: 11 Tân Hàng (alley off Tăng Bạt Hổ), Phường Chợ Lớn
0nw7att.order: Salt-roasted soft-shell crab tossed over a big flame, and Yangzhou fried rice
0nw7att.note: A family wok kitchen running for more than 40 years; a pot of bone broth is served free to diners.

r195o15.note: SaigonTV calls it one of the pricier crab soups in Cholon.

aatdfka.order: Cơm gà xối mỡ (crispy fried chicken rice)

w0k8q1h.note: A charity kitchen serving free vegetarian meals. If you visit, be respectful and leave room for people who need a meal.

xglly60.hours: Two sessions a day: from 5am, and from 4pm to 8pm

tj97zfj.price: 40,000 dong regular, 55,000 special; fried dough sticks 6,000 a plate

6449o1t.order: Vegetarian hủ tiếu and vegetarian bánh xèo (crispy pancake)

zx5w511.order: Hủ tiếu mì and sủi cảo (wontons)

2yc21tc.note: An old-school Chinese breakfast shop that fills up early.
src: Ăn Vặt Sài Gòn Và Du Lịch

pmxdref.addr: Opposite 507 Kênh Tân Hóa, Tân Phú
pmxdref.order: Sườn xào chua ngọt (sweet and sour pork ribs), a recipe the family has made for nearly 60 years

untlshz.order: Hong Kong-style mì vịt tiềm (herbal duck noodles); a good evening stop

x8f3u5g.addr: Phù Đổng Thiên Vương street, District 5
x8f3u5g.order: Shrimp har gow, siu mai, char siu and sweet and sour ribs
x8f3u5g.note: Cantonese and Hong Kong-style dim sum at fairly local prices.

mv4ucd9.addr: 103 Lê Hồng Phong, Phường Chợ Quán

ue7pdsy.order: Dry hủ tiếu mì with soup on the side, topped with sliced pork, beef balls, wontons, pork roll and quail eggs

xlgxs6k.hours: Only on the 1st and 15th days of the lunar month, from 6am until about 9am
xlgxs6k.order: Vegetarian hủ tiếu with napa cabbage and lotus seeds
xlgxs6k.note: Very busy on those days; check a lunar calendar before you go.

eaa5m3u.hours: 7am – 11am and 5pm – 9pm; closed on the 1st and 15th days of the lunar month

nh2jytx.note: A Chinese-style dessert shop with nearly 40 kinds of chè.

s0ye0jq.order: Bún thịt nướng (grilled pork noodles) and chè nhãn nhục (longan sweet soup) from the market stalls
s0ye0jq.note: A historic market around 100 years old; mornings are the liveliest.

7owuv3k.order: Dim sum, especially for a weekend family brunch

h414cna.order: Chinese-style chè, the lotus-flower dessert and the strawberry snow ice

7q9o2eh.note: A no-frills, cheap night spot with fast service.
